# CPAPOutcomes

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/CPAPOutcomes
Primary article: Electronic health record-derived outcomes in obstructive sleep apnea managed with positive airway pressure tracking systems
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5664/jcsm.9750
Journal record: https://jcsm.aasm.org/doi/10.5664/jcsm.9750
PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34725036/
PMC: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8883092/
PMID: 34725036
PMCID: PMC8883092
Paper-aligned commit: f64bc309860a34a8e6153da438086896c218486f

## Purpose

Legacy Python workflow for the CPAP outcomes paper. The script loads restricted EHR-derived Excel workbooks, compares pre/post CPAP measures, stratifies by PAP-tracking goal status, and produces aggregate text and figure outputs.

## Public Files

- `README.md`: human-facing project overview, run command, data restrictions, citation, and license.
- `CPAPOutcomeStats.py`: legacy analysis script.
- `CITATION.cff`: machine-readable repository and article citation metadata.
- `data_dictionary.md` and `data_dictionary.csv`: expected workbook sheets, columns, and derived variables.
- `AGENTS.md`: repository-specific instructions for coding agents.
- `output.txt`: historical aggregate text output.
- `combined difference histos.png`: historical aggregate figure.

## Restricted Inputs

Do not commit source workbooks. Default local paths are:

- `data/private/Full n977 (minus UARS) w dAHI use and outcomes.xlsm`
- `data/private/Full (minus UARS) meeting goals.xlsx`
- `data/private/Full (minus UARS) not meeting goals.xlsx`

Expected sheets: `Population`, `Systolic`, `Diastolic`, `SP02`, `BMI`, `CREAT`, and `HBA1C`.

## Run Command

```bash
python CPAPOutcomeStats.py \
  --combined-input "data/private/Full n977 (minus UARS) w dAHI use and outcomes.xlsm" \
  --at-goal-input "data/private/Full (minus UARS) meeting goals.xlsx" \
  --not-at-goal-input "data/private/Full (minus UARS) not meeting goals.xlsx" \
  --output-dir outputs/python
```

Outputs are written under `outputs/python/` by default. Full execution requires restricted local workbooks. `python CPAPOutcomeStats.py --help` does not require data.

## Data And License Boundaries

Repository code and documentation are MIT licensed. Restricted clinical data, source workbooks, row-level derived outputs, third-party materials, and publisher-formatted article files are excluded. Link the DOI, PubMed, and PMC records instead of copying full article text into this repository.

## Citation

Preferred article citation: Locke BW, Neill SE, Howe HE, Crotty MC, Kim J, Sundar KM. Electronic health record-derived outcomes in obstructive sleep apnea managed with positive airway pressure tracking systems. J Clin Sleep Med. 2022;18(3):885-894. doi:10.5664/jcsm.9750.

Use `CITATION.cff` for structured citation metadata and cite the repository commit or release used.

## Agent Cautions

- Treat `PAT_ID` and all workbooks as restricted.
- Do not regenerate root-level `output.txt` or `combined difference histos.png` from private data without explicit review.
- Keep generated outputs in ignored `outputs/`.
- Preserve legacy analysis logic unless the change is explicitly scientific.
- Validate CFF, README fences, and dictionary coverage before publishing changes.
